{
  "participants": [
    {
      "login": "frankomosh",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "questioned removing the assert from EncryptWallet since it does descriptor-specific work and may be called during migration"
    },
    {
      "login": "b-l-u-e",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "demonstrated that removing assert in EncryptWallet leads to later assertion failures and cited descriptor-specific calls"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "r:3772776156",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "EncryptWallet executes descriptor-specific work and may be called during legacy wallet migration, making the assertion necessary",
      "quote": "Why remove the assertion from `EncryptWallet()`? I think it also does descriptor-specific work",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author replied that EncryptWallet is not called during migration and only applies to descriptor wallets",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:6418541568"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:6418541568",
      "status_by_quote": "I don't see EncryptWallet being called from the migration workflow. Since it can't be called for legacy wallets and only for descriptor wallets, there seems no need to have this assertion within it."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:3920604921",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "Removing the assertion in EncryptWallet causes SIGABRT later in DescriptorScriptPubKeyMan or leaves the wallet in an inconsistent state",
      "quote": "seems with removing assertion leds to errors failing later",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author replied that the test scenario calling EncryptWallet on a non-descriptor wallet is contrived",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:6418541568"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:6418541568",
      "status_by_quote": "This seems quite a contrived test case where EncryptWallet is being made to be called from a non-descriptor wallet. Unless this scenario happens in a real world use case, I don't believe this contrived test case failure needs to be considered."
    }
  ],
  "support": [],
  "notes": "Author replied to both frankomosh and b-l-u-e regarding the EncryptWallet assertion and rebased over master.",
  "waiting_on": [
    {
      "on": "reviewer",
      "what": "frankomosh and b-l-u-e to review author's responses",
      "id": "c:6418541568"
    }
  ]
}
